name: Kum'isha's Endeavors
label: Quest
description: Kum'isha's Endeavors: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Even though the portal conjuration was a failure, I remain hopeful that my next attempt will be successful.
The hope of the Draenei is as fervent as your greed for trinkets, traveler. Go back out into these cursed lands and recover another flawless draenethyst sphere.
Of course, the choice to take on this task is completely left to you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found another flawless draenethyst sphere?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Simply amazing. I had doubted that you could find another sphere, yet here it is, pulsating in my hands.
Should you find anymore--and I believe this to be an impossibility--return them to me and I shall reward you again.
